review.notes: Full re-review. All five findings and six minor remarks of the previous review are repaired. New findings: the involution of 2.5 as written is the identity on SO0(n,1) (its Check is false); the proof route of the Paley-Wiener theorem of 1.3 does not reach beta = -1/2 and is circular with 4.2 for even n. Sample: all fifteen seeded targets recomputed numerically or by hand (table in the report), including the new inversion with discrete terms at three parameter pairs; DLMF 15.9.11-15.9.14, 15.4.11, 15.4.15 read at their locators; the four books, Koornwinder (1984, 1975) and Flensted-Jensen (1972) are paywalled and not verifiable. All cross-roadmap citations resolved on main or at the open heads. Automatic checks: dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe on 11 statements closes only the three marked sanity checks; the empty-section-header report and the unresolved-name lead set aside as false positives.
